name: Duelist
description:
FLAVOR:

  • Duelist

  • Precision combat, maneuverability

  • Must maintain good form!

WEAPONS

  • Light, common, light firearms

  • Light armor, no helms

ENGAGEMENT:

  • Many small dice

  • Lots of success options, fancy

ABILITIES

  • Form: benefits while maintaining, penalties while out of form

  • Dual wielding

  • Extra movement as reaction?

novizio.engagement:
x WITS

You have the Compass, Feint, Invitation, Parry, Manchette, Retreat and Riposte Engagement successes.
novizio.abilities: You start each Combat with 0 MP. You earn MP by winning Engagements, via your Good Form ability.
novizio.description:
You have the Demand Satisfaction and Good Form abilities. Also choose one of these additional abilities, ignoring its XP cost:

  • Press Advantage

  • Quick Draw

  • Lunge
